== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Awakened objects are items that have undergone a transformative process performed by [[Readers]]. This procedure alters an object's physical appearance and grants it enhanced capabilities, sometimes providing powers that the item did not naturally possess. The [[Awakening]] process involves combining [[Intent]] from three distinct sources: the object itself, its owner, and [[the Reader]]. Success is more probable when the item holds significant meaning for both the owner and [[the Reader]]. Once an object has been Awakened, it is locked into a permanent form and can no longer be used to absorb further [[Intent]] or undergo the [[Awakening]] process again. These objects often exhibit a degree of self-awareness or independence, with their level of consciousness tied to the original [[Intent]] of the item. While they can demonstrate surprising autonomy, such as assisting a person in survival situations, they are not equivalent to living humans. Because of their complexity, determining the specific nature or abilities of an [[Awakened object]] typically requires time and careful study. In combat, these items serve as [[Vessels]] for [[Soulbound]] individuals, acting as the source of their supernatural abilities. Consequently, a [[Soulbound]]'s power can be neutralized by destroying or seizing their [[Vessel]]. While the process can create aesthetically beautiful or highly functional tools, it carries risks; the transformation may result in mechanical failures where parts work against one another, or the process can negatively impact the mental state of those involved.}}
